faq.a: Necati is associated with the Arabic form نَجَاتِي, whose core sense is necati; of salvation (relative form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Necati?
faq.a: Necati is associated with Arabic. Necati is the Turkish form of Arabic نَجَاتِيّ (Najātī), the relative form of نَجَاة (salvation), used as a male given name.
Yes — the underlying form نَجَاتِي is Arabic.
Necati can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Necati should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Najātī is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Necati mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Necati is rendered نجاتی and carries the sense نجاتی، نجات سے منسوب.

faq.q: What does Necati mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Necati is rendered نجاتی and carries the sense نجاتی، منسوب به نجات.
A romanized syllable approximation is ne-ca-ti. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Necati?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Necati, necati. Script forms are نجاتي, نجاتی, نَجَاتِي, नजाती.

faq.q: Is Necati a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
